lane: MONEY AND PEOPLE (money, people, home admin, work, creative except the comic)

features.name: Your month
features.does: Money out, money in and what is left over, the pounds-a-day pace, each category with its share and change since last month, where it went most, and every payment searchable; tap a payment to file it under another category
features.note: Only as fresh as the last statement he gives; there is no bank link (by design)

features.name: Budgets
features.does: A bar for each budget, what is left, what that comes to a day, and set, change or remove in two taps
features.note: One budget per category; there is no carry-over from month to month

features.name: Bills and subscriptions
features.does: Repeating payments found in his statements plus the bills he showed HOME, in date order, with totals for the next 30 days, a month and a year, any price rise, and the ones that look stopped
features.note: Subscriptions are found by the same amount to the same name, so one whose amount changes every month is missed

features.name: Trends
features.does: The last six months side by side, the average, the dearest and cheapest months, and one category across them
features.note: Only months he gave a statement for

features.name: Paste a statement
features.does: A bank CSV or PDF read by plain rules on the phone and the brain; no model sees it
features.note: UK bank formats; some PDFs read poorly

features.name: Spending card
features.does: The older spending card: month, year, since last month, CSV export, forget all
features.note: Belongs to the plan lane's screen and still uses its own old colours; it overlaps the MONEY app

features.name: Money nudges
features.where: HOME → Brief money line, and the Agenda's spending card
say: (said on its own once a day)
features.does: A renewal this week, a price that went up, the month running hot: each said once

features.name: Money in the chat
say: what have I spent this week?
features.does: Spends he tells me, the week, fuel prices near a saved place, a trip's cost, price watches, splitting a bill, round-ups, payday, what-if savings, warranties
features.note: These live in the chat only; none has a page on the MONEY screen yet

features.name: Your people
features.does: Everyone he told me about, A to Z, searchable, with birthday, notes, gift ideas, copyable contact details, keep a birthday, and forget (asks once more)
features.note: There is no editing of a note; only adding or forgetting

features.name: Coming up
features.does: Every birthday (with age turning), date, plan and call a year ahead, with reminders a week before and on the day; keep a birthday or a date there

features.name: Group plan
say: plan: pub on Friday at 8 at the Crown, asked Ali, Sam and Jo
Jo's in, Sam can't make it
features.does: One plan with yes, maybe or no under each name; make it or call it off on the screen; nobody is messaged

features.name: Messages, cards and thank-yous in his voice
say: write a birthday message for Mum
a thank-you note for Ali for the lift
features.does: Drafts shown to him first, never sent
features.note: There is no page on the PEOPLE screen for these

features.name: Due at home
features.does: Bins, bills and reminders in date order

features.name: Bin days
say: bins are Tuesday, recycling every other Tuesday
features.does: Bin days kept from his words or his council's pasted page; a moved collection
features.note: There is no automatic council lookup

features.name: Bills
features.does: Bills photographed or pasted, read on the phone, unpaid first with the total still to pay, mark paid
features.note: A paid bill disappears from the page and cannot be forgotten there (the brain sends only unpaid ones)

features.name: Meter readings
features.does: Photograph the dial or type it; readings kept
features.note: There is no usage chart or cost estimate from the readings yet

features.name: Rooms (home inventory)
say: the lounge has a TV and a sofa
features.does: Each room's things, from words or a photo, made into a CSV for his insurer
features.note: There are no values or receipts per item

features.name: To-do
say: add to my to-do: send the invoice by Friday
features.does: Grouped Late, Today, Coming up, Any time, Done, with a count line
features.note: There are no projects, repeats or priorities

features.name: Interview practice
say: interview practice for a shop job
features.does: Questions asked aloud, his answer timed by voice or typing, a plain critique

features.name: Documents
say: a cover letter for this ad
features.does: A CV, cover letter, email, meeting summary or timesheet to copy, share or open in mail
features.note: Made in the chat; the page shows only the last one from this visit, and there is no saved library

features.name: Pomodoro
features.does: Eight focus and break timers

features.name: Song and drum pads
features.does: A tune made by code and played on his tap, drum pads, saved as WAV or MIDI

features.name: Poster, birthday card, logo, palette
features.where: LIFE → CREATIVE → Poster / Card / Logo / Palette
features.does: Drawn on the phone, saved as PNG or SVG on his tap
features.note: Light on editing: no moving parts around by hand

features.name: Drawing prompt
features.does: A drawing idea for today

upward.idea: Money calendar: a month grid with every bill, subscription and payday on its day
upward.why: He sees at a glance which days are heavy
upward.builds_on: Bills and subscriptions, payday in the chat

upward.idea: Safe to spend: what is left until payday after the bills still due
upward.why: One number that answers whether he can afford something; plain sums, no forecast

upward.idea: Rules he can see and edit: 'every TESCO is groceries', with the count of payments each rule files
upward.why: Full control over how his money is sorted

upward.idea: Split one payment across categories (a supermarket shop that was half household)
Savings goals with a bar and a date: 'holiday £800 by June', and what that is a month
upward.why: Turns spending into something he is aiming at

upward.idea: Year in review page: totals, biggest months, subscriptions started and stopped, printable
upward.why: The tax-year or new-year look-back the big apps sell

upward.idea: Cancel helper: for a subscription, the public cancel page and steps from the company's own site
upward.why: Saves him the hunt; public sources only
upward.builds_on: Bills and subscriptions, the web reader

upward.idea: Statement reminder: on the 2nd of the month, a nudge to add last month's statement
upward.why: Keeps every page fresh without a bank link

upward.idea: People: edit or remove one note, and a photo he adds himself for each person
Gift list per person: ideas saved, bought, with price, and what he gave last year
upward.why: Never repeat a present; spending ties in

upward.idea: Several group plans at once, each with its own page
upward.why: Real social life has more than one plan

upward.idea: Meter usage chart and cost estimate from his own readings and his tariff (a first estimate)
upward.why: Sees energy use climbing before the bill does

upward.idea: Bills archive: paid bills kept, forgettable, with a yearly total per supplier
upward.why: Fixes the gap where paid bills vanish; compare each year
upward.builds_on: HOME Bills, the brain's bills list

upward.idea: To-do repeats, priorities and projects, plus a Today view in the Brief
Documents library: every CV, letter and email kept, versioned, re-openable in the DOCS editor
upward.why: Work done once is never lost

sideways.idea: Warranties and receipts page: a photo of the receipt, the end date, a reminder before it runs out
sideways.builds_on: Warranty in the chat, the phone's photo reading, Rooms inventory

sideways.idea: Price watches page: everything he is watching, with the price history
sideways.why: The chat ability gets a home

sideways.idea: Bill splitter page for a household: who owes whom from shared bills, settled on a tap
sideways.why: Flatmates and family costs without an app subscription
sideways.builds_on: Split in the chat, HOME Bills

sideways.idea: Car costs: fuel, MOT, insurance and tax due dates, with cost per month
sideways.why: The car's money in one place
sideways.builds_on: Fuel prices, the car screen's MOT data, Bills

sideways.idea: Home maintenance schedule: boiler service, smoke alarm test, gutters, with reminders
sideways.why: Home admin a specialist app would have

sideways.idea: Moving-house checklist: who to tell, readings to take, bins at the new address
sideways.why: A big life event handled step by step

sideways.idea: Christmas and birthday budget: one pot per occasion, linked to gifts per person
Job applications tracker: role, date applied, stage, follow-up reminder
Meeting prep: an agenda draft and notes page that becomes a summary afterwards
Invites and party pages made in CREATIVE from a group plan (shared only on his tap)
sideways.why: A plan becomes something he can send

sideways.idea: Sound packs and tempo for the drum pads, and loops he can record
sideways.why: The music pages grow into a small studio

sideways.idea: Household documents vault: tenancy, insurance and council tax papers with their renewal dates
sideways.why: Everything home-admin in one safe place on the phone
sideways.builds_on: HOME Bills reading, reminders, the Library

cross.idea: Spending by place: what he spent near Work or Dad's, on the map
cross.why: See where money goes, from his saved places only, never live GPS

cross.idea: Recipes priced from his own grocery spending, and a meal plan that fits his groceries budget
Point the Lens at a bill or receipt to add it to HOME Bills or Warranties
Budgets and bills as a SHEETS spreadsheet he can edit, kept in sync
cross.why: Power-user view of his own money

cross.idea: Birthday cards and messages drafted from Coming up with one tap, in his voice, sent only on APPROVE
cross.why: Never miss a birthday, never auto-send

cross.idea: A morning Brief line: bills due today, birthdays this week, today's to-do
cross.why: The day's admin in one breath
